issue_request: Applied/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core search clarification for R6 asking to clarify how multiple chained parameters through repeating Patient.generalPractitioner are evaluated: each chain builds its own Patient set, the sets are joined with AND at the Patient level, and different practitioners can satisfy name and address criteria.

additional_context: FHIR-52942 is the latest issue in the same chained-search paragraph family as FHIR-14951 and FHIR-34023. The motivating Zulip #implementers thread shows confusion about whether the example was OR logic; the clarification preserved the existing semantics and explained that AND joining occurs after each chain is evaluated independently.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The retained sentence 'E.g., the chains are evaluated separately' is redundant but consistent with the approved semantics.
